# Aromatics.com

> > Aromatics.com is a certified organic aromatherapy retailer offering therapeutic-grade essential oils, carrier oils, blends, and wellness products with 20+ years of expertise in sustainable sourcing.

Aromatics International operates aromatics.com as a comprehensive online destination for pure, therapeutic-grade aromatherapy products. The site emphasizes organic certification, sustainable sourcing, and educational resources for both budding and professional aromatherapists.

## Key Topics

- Essential Oils
- Carrier Oils
- Aromatherapy Blends
- Sustainable Sourcing
- Therapeutic Grade
- Diffusers
- Hydrosols
- Natural Wellness
- Organic Certification
- Lavender Essential Oil
- Frankincense
- Jojoba Oil
- Natural Skincare
- Aromatherapy Education

## Core Products & Collections

- [Homepage](https://www.aromatics.com): Homepage showcasing certified organic essential oils, carrier oils, and aromatherapy products.
- [Shop All Products](https://www.aromatics.com/collections/all-products): Complete aromatherapy product collection including oils, carriers, and hydrosols.
- [Products Catalog](https://www.aromatics.com/collections/all): Main product catalog featuring essential oils, diffusers, blends, and wellness products.
- [On Sale Products](https://www.aromatics.com/collections/on-sale): Discounted essential oils, carriers, and blends with savings up to 70%.

## Essential Oils & Blends

- [Essential Oil Singles](https://www.aromatics.com/collections/essential-oil-singles): Pure, therapeutic-grade single essential oils sustainably produced and tested.
- [Essential Oil Blends](https://www.aromatics.com/collections/essential-oil-blends): Crafted essential oil blends for wellness using 20+ years of aromatherapy expertise.
- [Hydrosols](https://www.aromatics.com/collections/hydrosols-all): Steam-distilled aromatic waters with therapeutic benefits and minimal safety concerns.

## Carrier Oils & Botanicals

- [Carrier Oils](https://www.aromatics.com/collections/carrier-oils): Unrefined therapeutic carrier oils including jojoba, argan, and specialty blends.
- [Butters & Waxes](https://www.aromatics.com/collections/butters-and-waxes): Unrefined butters and waxes for body butter and lotion essential oil blends.
- [Clays & Salts](https://www.aromatics.com/collections/clays-and-salts): Earth minerals and clays for wound care, detoxifying, and skincare.
- [Lotions, Soaps & Gels](https://www.aromatics.com/collections/lotions-soaps-and-gels): Emulsifiers, soaps, and healing body lotions for natural skincare.
- [Resins & Burnables](https://www.aromatics.com/collections/resins-and-burnables): Frankincense and myrrh resins with charcoal for air cleansing.
- [All Carriers](https://www.aromatics.com/collections/carriers-all): Exotic butters, oils, gels, salts, and clays with skin-nourishing benefits.

## Diffusers & Application Tools

- [Diffusers & Inhalers](https://www.aromatics.com/collections/diffusers-and-inhalers): Diffusers and personal inhalers for therapeutic aromatherapy delivery.
- [Blending Tools & Cases](https://www.aromatics.com/collections/blending-tools-and-cases): Blending tools and cases for precision essential oil blend creation.
- [Containers & Packaging](https://www.aromatics.com/collections/containers): High-quality containers for storing and finishing aromatherapy projects.

## Educational Resources

- [Aromatherapy Books](https://www.aromatics.com/collections/books): Aromatherapy books and guides for budding and professional aromatherapists.
